from: reel 1456768899288979 (sunlit wooden cabin, patchwork quilt, sleeping cats, girl in white among hanging plants)
block: Bright cottagecore interior film still, real camera, slight wide angle, locked or very slow drift, high-key warm afternoon sun through windows, honey and cream palette, soft lifted shadows, low contrast, fresh green plants. A small wooden cottage room: plank walls, white lace curtains, a low bed with a patchwork quilt, bookshelves, a vintage cream electric fan, potted monstera, trailing vines and dried flowers hanging in a glass sunroom, a garden beyond an open door. A cat asleep in a sun patch, or a young woman in a white dress seen from behind or with her face turned away, absorbed in a small task. Nobody looks at the camera.

from: rangchieuwanxia reels 1707419487720433, 1077197601614341, 1795058911789308 (home vlog: latte, clay pot on the stove, roses, a basket of fruit, picking tomatoes)
block: Warm home-vlog film still, real handheld camera, 50mm close-ups with very shallow depth of field, golden late-afternoon light, amber and cream grade, soft contrast, light grain. Small daily rituals seen as hands and details: a latte in a ceramic cup, a black clay pot steaming on a gas stove, a few simple dishes on a wooden table, orange roses being trimmed, a wicker basket of grapes, apples and greens, tomatoes picked in a small garden behind a bamboo fence, greens washed in a basin. A young woman in a cream knit or a straw hat seen from behind, over the shoulder, or only her hands; a cat on the kitchen counter. Nobody looks at the camera.

from: rangchieuwanxia reels 1694575998682300, 1874408983718651, 1085408691210360, 1456825049117172 (red maples behind tall windows, a Chinese garden lattice window, ginkgo gold, summer sun through leaves)
block: Seasonal film still, real camera, locked or very slow push-in, wide and medium-wide, natural light, soft film grade, gentle grain. One strong season colour fills the frame (crimson maple, gold ginkgo, pink blossom or bright summer green), often framed by something dark in the foreground: a doorway, a window, a station canopy, overhanging trees. People are small and alone, in silhouette or from behind, faces turned away or in shadow. The place, people and objects are exactly the ones the shot names; the season colour is the only thing this look adds.
